guard: A closure called before the declaration ran finds the dead zone at run time too, on both runners. (FAIL-FAST suite: markers are upstream of the cells they guard.)

mutations.name: the interpreter never materializes the dead zone, so an early call reads the outer scope
mutations.expectRed: a closure called BEFORE the declaration ran finds the dead zone on both sides
mutations.completionMarker: ok a program that logs a literal
mutations.cell: a closure called BEFORE the declaration ran finds the dead zone on both sides
mutations.note: Without the pre-pass the early call raises L2001 (name not yet in any env) for a module-level binding — or, for a shadowing block, silently reads the outer value — while node raises ReferenceError; the bothThrow cell requires the interpreter side to throw with the SAME log prefix, and the interpreter completing or logging differently reddens it.
